args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: r01–r08.
- Checks: rigid-body invariance (0.74–0.80 vs 2.0 %/h) and closure (0.11 vs 1.0 px/h) pass in every run. All runs report the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. Its values (3.79–3.86 vs 3.25 %/h) fit the root width changing, which is why the width-free ratio is used.
- Two groups: r01, r04, r05, r07, r08 and r02, r03, r06. The ±2.13 z-scores come only from a batch MAD of zero. The real differences are small: REGR peak 52.96 vs 53.15 %/h, peak position 421 µm in both, growth zone 684 vs 695 µm, largest flank difference −3.79 vs −3.86 %/h, width-free ratio max −0.019 vs 0.074.
- Caveat: in r02, r03 and r06 the largest flank difference sits at 284 µm instead of 1074 µm. Because the two flank-difference minima are almost equal in size, I treat this as a weak shape signal, not a fault. r02's settings were clean (stride 1, no registration or masking). I did not open the records for r03 and r06.
- Remedies: every run kept one remedy (the width-free ratio). r05 and r06 each had one roll back, and their final measurements match their groups.
- No flagged runs, so they have nothing in common to note.
